The '''RD-17A''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during the [[Galactic War]], between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Heavy variants were also used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[war against Zakuul]].
